$comment: Example for ~/.claude/crew-chief-guard.json. With the built-in rules, these rules reproduce a personal prod-guard mod. Levels: deny = never runs; confirm = the first attempt is stopped with a checklist and the identical command passes on retry (within confirmTtlMinutes); warn = runs, then a reminder. Writes to branch databases (.mdb, .accdb, /databases/) stay deny. Copies touching them, license or private key files (lic-*.key, private*.key|pem, *_private*.key|pem) and the 'never open a branch' rule are confirm: the agent must stop, check and decide before it can go on. The ssh gate is off here; set ssh.mode to gate and list your production hosts to use it.

rules.text: write to a branch database path (.mdb / .accdb / databases/)
write to a license or private key file
read of a license or private key file
delete, move or overwrite on a branch database path (.mdb / databases/)
copy touching a branch database path; check the destination is not the original
command reads, copies or stages a license or private key file
creates or deletes a git branch (your rule: never open a branch unless told)
